description: Napster 1.0.3 — Audio Diagnostics, HTTP Streaming Add-ons, Lossless FLAC Export, and Per-Network Quality Preferences.

changelog.title: Truth-First Audio Diagnostics & Route Telemetry
items: Real-time decoder telemetry monitoring actual Media3 audio input format, codec, sample rate, bit depth, and bitrate.
Downgrade detection flagging when streams claiming lossless quality are delivered lossy or downsampled.
Active hardware output route classification (Speaker, Wired Headset, USB DAC, HDMI, Audio Dock).
Bluetooth A2DP telemetry detecting negotiated codecs (LDAC, aptX HD, aptX Adaptive, AAC, SBC, Samsung Seamless Codec) without unverified bit-perfect claims.

changelog.title: HTTP Streaming Add-ons
items: Modular support for external streaming add-on servers using open JSON manifest standards.
Manifest capability discovery, resource verification, and configurable quality tiers.
In-flight request deduplication via SharedCalls protecting self-hosted server instances.
HTTP 429 Retry-After backoff and client-side cooldown timers.
Silent track mismatch guard strictly rejecting remixes, live performances, and acoustic edits when studio tracks are requested.

changelog.title: Lossless FLAC Export & Metadata Tagging
items: Direct export of cached lossless FLAC audio to user-selected storage via Android Storage Access Framework.
FlacTagger embeds Vorbis comments (Title, Artist, Album), album cover art, and synchronized/word lyrics.
Raw audio frame streams are preserved byte-for-byte untouched with zero transcoding artifacts.
Honest format handling: non-FLAC streams are cleanly converted to M4A/AAC rather than falsely disguised as FLAC.

changelog.title: Per-Network Quality & Storage Controls
items: Independent audio quality preferences for Wi-Fi and Cellular networks.
Seamless handover adaptation dynamically re-evaluating quality upon network changes without unnecessary playback reloads.
Data Saver mode instantly forces efficient low-bitrate playback across all networks.
Storage settings featuring granular player and download cache monitoring and one-tap cache eviction.
